description: A gleeful old witch: crackly, cackling, high and sing-song, sly and mischievous.
origin: Voice design on the Mac Studio, seed 23 of 5 takes (Michael's pick), repetition_penalty 1.2, cfg 4. The clip is the voice.
design_instruct: A gleeful old witch: a crackly, cackling female voice, high and sing-song, sly and mischievous, dripping with delight at her own cleverness, with sudden wicked chuckles between phrases.
ref_text: (laugh) Well, well, well. What have we here? A visitor, at this hour, and without so much as a gift for the witch of the woods. Come closer, dearie, come closer. I have a cauldron on the boil, a cat who does not like strangers, and a recipe that calls for one more ingredient. (laugh) Do not worry. I am only joking. Mostly.
